迈克尔 · 2026年11月

notes.hz: 你好！我叫迈克尔，我是德国人，是工程师，做控制、人工智能和自动化。
notes.py: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Màikè'ěr, wǒ shì Déguó rén, shì gōngchéngshī, zuò kòngzhì, réngōng zhìnéng hé zìdònghuà.
notes.en: Hello! I'm Michael, I'm German, an engineer in control, AI and automation.

notes.hz: 我的英语、荷兰语和德语说得很流利，也会说一点儿西班牙语和法语。
notes.py: Wǒ de Yīngyǔ, Hélányǔ hé Déyǔ shuō de hěn liúlì, yě huì shuō yìdiǎnr Xībānyáyǔ hé Fǎyǔ.
notes.en: I speak English, Dutch and German fluently, and a little Spanish and French.

notes.hz: 现在我想学中文：我想挑战自己，用科技，也想让它变成一段美好的旅程，带我去中国。
notes.py: Xiànzài wǒ xiǎng xué Zhōngwén: wǒ xiǎng tiǎozhàn zìjǐ, yòng kējì, yě xiǎng ràng tā biànchéng yí duàn měihǎo de lǚchéng, dài wǒ qù Zhōngguó.
notes.en: Now I want to learn Chinese: to challenge myself, to use technology, and to make it a beautiful journey that takes me to China.

notes.hz: 我喜欢网球、骑自行车、瑜伽、道家，还有机器人和人工智能。
notes.py: Wǒ xǐhuan wǎngqiú, qí zìxíngchē, yújiā, Dàojiā, hái yǒu jīqìrén hé réngōng zhìnéng.
notes.en: I like tennis, cycling, yoga, Taoism, and robots and AI.

notes.hz: 我的问题是：用科技学中文，怎么学才又好又美？
notes.py: Wǒ de wèntí shì: yòng kējì xué Zhōngwén, zěnme xué cái yòu hǎo yòu měi?
notes.en: My question: learning Chinese with technology, how can it be both effective and beautiful?

02 · 迈克尔的中文路线图

notes.hz: 现在说说我学中文的路，我现在在哪儿。
notes.py: Xiànzài shuōshuo wǒ xué Zhōngwén de lù, wǒ xiànzài zài nǎr.
notes.en: Now about my Chinese learning journey, and where I stand.

notes.hz: 去年我开始用Duolingo，我很喜欢中文。我很尊重汉字，因为我的字一直写得不好看，德语也是。可是后来我喜欢上了汉字，还给女儿画了一张生日画。
notes.py: Qùnián wǒ kāishǐ yòng Duolingo, wǒ hěn xǐhuan Zhōngwén. Yì kāishǐ wǒ yǒudiǎnr pà dú Hànzì, xiě Hànzì, kěshì hòulái wǒ xǐhuan shàng le, hái gěi nǚ'ér huàle yì zhāng shēngrì huà.
notes.en: Last year I started with Duolingo and liked Chinese a lot. I had a lot of respect for Hanzi, because my handwriting was never good, not even in German. But then I came to love it, and I even drew a birthday picture for my daughter.

notes.hz: 今年我重新开始了：用Du Chinese阅读，用一点儿Duolingo，还用Anki卡片。后来我开始上网课，非常有意思。
notes.py: Jīnnián wǒ chóngxīn kāishǐ le: yòng Du Chinese yuèdú, yòng yìdiǎnr Duolingo, hái yòng Anki kǎpiàn. Hòulái wǒ kāishǐ shàng wǎngkè, fēicháng yǒu yìsi.
notes.en: This year I started again: reading with Du Chinese, a little Duolingo, and Anki flashcards. Then I started online lessons, which is really fun.

notes.hz: 我没上过正式的中文课，所以我常常说错，简单的话也说不好。可是我开始用HSK考试测试自己：学了一个半月，一级模拟考试我考了满分。没想到二级也过了。三级一开始太难了，因为都是汉字，第一次模拟考试我刚刚及格。可是现在我每天做一次模拟考试，分数越来越高：181、210，最近一次241分（满分300）。
notes.py: Wǒ méi shàngguo zhèngshì de Zhōngwén kè, suǒyǐ wǒ chángcháng shuō cuò, jiǎndān de huà yě shuō bu hǎo. Kěshì wǒ kāishǐ yòng HSK kǎoshì cèshì zìjǐ: xuéle yí ge bàn yuè, yī jí mónǐ kǎoshì wǒ kǎole mǎnfēn. Méi xiǎngdào èr jí yě guò le. Sān jí yì kāishǐ tài nán le, yīnwèi dōu shì Hànzì, dì yī cì mónǐ kǎoshì wǒ gānggāng jígé. Kěshì xiànzài wǒ měitiān zuò yí cì mónǐ kǎoshì, fēnshù yuè lái yuè gāo: yìbǎi bāshíyī, èrbǎi yīshí, zuìjìn yí cì èrbǎi sìshíyī fēn (mǎnfēn sānbǎi).
notes.en: I never took a proper Chinese class, so I make many mistakes and can't say simple things well. But I started testing myself with the HSK: after a month and a half I got full marks in the level 1 practice test. To my surprise I passed level 2 too. Level 3 was very hard at first, because it is all Hanzi: I only just passed my first practice test. But now I do a practice test every day and my scores keep rising: 181, 210, and most recently 241 out of 300.

notes.hz: 现在我在准备三级考试，十一月二十一号考。十二月我再考一次，因为新的三级更难。2027年我想考四级。
notes.py: Xiànzài wǒ zài zhǔnbèi sān jí kǎoshì, shíyī yuè èrshíyī hào kǎo. Shí'èr yuè wǒ zài kǎo yí cì, yīnwèi xīn de sān jí gèng nán. Èr líng èr qī nián wǒ xiǎng kǎo sì jí.
notes.en: Now I'm preparing for HSK 3; the exam is on 21 November. In December I take it again, because the new HSK 3 is harder. In 2027 I want to take HSK 4.

03 · 迈克尔的中文路线图

notes.hz: 三级的词我都会了，那就没问题了，对吧？
notes.py: Sān jí de cí wǒ dōu huì le, nà jiù méi wèntí le, duì ba?
notes.en: If I know all the HSK 3 words, I'll be fine, right?

notes.hz: 所以我做了工程师会做的事。我下载了一套网上的Anki卡片，用AI调好了设置。然后我让AI把它做成很现代的卡片，我拼命地学，想最快学会新版三级的一千个词。我还做了写字卡片：看拼音，写汉字，再跟标准字比较。
notes.py: Suǒyǐ wǒ zuòle gōngchéngshī huì zuò de shì. Wǒ xiàzǎile yí tào wǎngshang de Anki kǎpiàn, yòng AI tiáohǎole shèzhì. Ránhòu wǒ ràng AI bǎ tā zuòchéng hěn xiàndài de kǎpiàn, wǒ pīnmìng de xué, xiǎng zuì kuài xuéhuì xīnbǎn sān jí de yìqiān ge cí. Wǒ hái zuòle xiězì kǎpiàn: kàn pīnyīn, xiě Hànzì, zài gēn biāozhǔn zì bǐjiào.
notes.en: So I did what an engineer does. I downloaded an Anki deck and tuned the settings with AI. Then I had AI turn it into a very modern deck, and I went all in to learn the 1,000 words of the new HSK 3 as fast as possible. I also made a handwriting deck: see the pinyin, write the character, compare it with the model.

notes.hz: 现在没问题了吧？不！每个词我都认识，可是这没有用。我读得慢，听得慢，语法也不太懂。
notes.py: Xiànzài méi wèntí le ba? Bù! Měi ge cí wǒ dōu rènshi, kěshì zhè méiyǒu yòng. Wǒ dú de màn, tīng de màn, yǔfǎ yě bú tài dǒng.
notes.en: So now I'm fine, right? No! I know every word, but that's no use. I read slowly, listen slowly, and don't really understand the grammar.

notes.hz: 只学词是不行的。词活在句子里：学语言要靠语境，也要去感觉这门语言。
notes.py: Zhǐ xué cí shì bù xíng de. Cí huó zài jùzi lǐ: xué yǔyán yào kào yǔjìng, yě yào qù gǎnjué zhè mén yǔyán.
notes.en: Learning only words doesn't work. Words live in sentences: learning a language depends on context, and on feeling the language.

04 · 迈克尔的中文路线图

notes.hz: 我为什么做这些？为了说话：跟中国人说话，在课上说话。说话是生活在新语言里最直接的方式。可是说话需要很多基础，我现在说得还很少。
notes.py: Wǒ wèishénme zuò zhèxiē? Wèile shuōhuà: gēn Zhōngguó rén shuōhuà, zài kè shang shuōhuà. Shuōhuà shì shēnghuó zài xīn yǔyán lǐ zuì zhíjiē de fāngshì. Kěshì shuōhuà xūyào hěn duō jīchǔ, wǒ xiànzài shuō de hái hěn shǎo.
notes.en: Why am I doing all this? To speak: with Chinese people, and in my lessons. Speaking is the most direct way of living in a new language. But it needs a lot of foundation, and my speaking is still very limited.

notes.hz: 第一个问题是语法，我有一点儿骄傲。上学的时候，语法对我来说一直很简单。中文没有动词变化，也没有格，所以我觉得中文语法很容易。可是中文语法很细：了、就和才、把、语序。错了，意思就变了。
notes.py: Dì-yī ge wèntí shì yǔfǎ, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jiāo'ào. Shàngxué de shíhou, yǔfǎ duì wǒ lái shuō yìzhí hěn jiǎndān. Zhōngwén méiyǒu dòngcí biànhuà, yě méiyǒu gé, suǒyǐ wǒ juéde Zhōngwén yǔfǎ hěn róngyì. Kěshì Zhōngwén yǔfǎ hěn xì: le, jiù hé cái, bǎ, yǔxù. Cuò le, yìsi jiù biàn le.
notes.en: The first problem is grammar, and I was a bit arrogant. At school grammar was always easy for me. Chinese has no verb endings and no cases, so I thought Chinese grammar was easy. But it is very subtle: 了, 就 and 才, 把, word order. Get it wrong and the meaning changes.

notes.hz: 第二和第三个问题是阅读和听力。问题就是速度。汉字我认识，可是读得很慢；别人说得快，我就跟不上。
notes.py: Dì-èr hé dì-sān ge wèntí shì yuèdú hé tīnglì. Wèntí jiù shì sùdù. Hànzì wǒ rènshi, kěshì dú de hěn màn; biérén shuō de kuài, wǒ jiù gēn bu shàng.
notes.en: The second and third problems are reading and listening. The problem is simply speed. I know the characters but read slowly; when people speak fast, I can't keep up.

notes.hz: 第四个问题我完全没想到：手写。我以为可以打字。后来我才知道考试用纸和笔，每个汉字都要自己写。所以我从零开始。
notes.py: Dì-sì ge wèntí wǒ wánquán méi xiǎngdào: shǒuxiě. Wǒ yǐwéi kěyǐ dǎzì. Hòulái wǒ cái zhīdào kǎoshì yòng zhǐ hé bǐ, měi ge Hànzì dōu yào zìjǐ xiě. Suǒyǐ wǒ cóng líng kāishǐ.
notes.en: The fourth problem I didn't see coming at all: handwriting. I thought I could type. Only later did I learn the exam is on paper, and every character must be written by hand. So I started from zero.

notes.hz: 语法要理解。阅读和听力要多读、多听。手写要多练。
notes.py: Yǔfǎ yào lǐjiě. Yuèdú hé tīnglì yào duō dú, duō tīng. Shǒuxiě yào duō liàn.
notes.en: Grammar needs understanding. Reading and listening need lots of reading and listening. Handwriting needs practice.

05 · 迈克尔的中文路线图

notes.hz: 工程师有四个问题，会怎么办？给每个问题做一个工具。有了AI，每个工具只要一两个晚上。
notes.py: Gōngchéngshī yǒu sì ge wèntí, huì zěnme bàn? Gěi měi ge wèntí zuò yí ge gōngjù. Yǒule AI, měi ge gōngjù zhǐ yào yì liǎng ge wǎnshang.
notes.en: What does an engineer do with four problems? He builds a tool for each one. With AI, each tool took only an evening or two.

notes.hz: 阅读：一个跟考试一模一样的练习，有计时。十月一道配对题我要四分钟，几个星期以后不到一分钟。
notes.py: Yuèdú: yí ge gēn kǎoshì yìmúyíyàng de liànxí, yǒu jìshí. Shí yuè yí dào pèiduì tí wǒ yào sì fēnzhōng, jǐ ge xīngqī yǐhòu bú dào yì fēnzhōng.
notes.en: Reading: a timed trainer exactly like the exam. In October one matching question took me four minutes; a few weeks later, less than one.

notes.hz: 听力和阅读速度：小故事。我一边读一边听，然后回答问题。语法：一个语法练习，有25个语法点，每天快速复习一遍。
notes.py: Tīnglì hé yuèdú sùdù: xiǎo gùshi. Wǒ yìbiān dú yìbiān tīng, ránhòu huídá wèntí. Yǔfǎ: yí ge yǔfǎ liànxí, yǒu èrshíwǔ ge yǔfǎ diǎn, měitiān kuàisù fùxí yí biàn.
notes.en: For listening and reading speed: short stories. I read along, listen, then answer questions. Grammar: a grammar trainer with 25 grammar points, reviewed quickly every day.

notes.hz: 书写：像考试一样的练习，排列句子，看拼音写汉字。手写：一个练习和一套卡片，每个汉字我都自己写，再跟标准字比较。这些工具都在这个网站上，你可以自己试试。
notes.py: Shūxiě: xiàng kǎoshì yíyàng de liànxí, páiliè jùzi, kàn pīnyīn xiě Hànzì. Shǒuxiě: yí ge liànxí hé yí tào kǎpiàn, měi ge Hànzì wǒ dōu zìjǐ xiě, zài gēn biāozhǔn zì bǐjiào. Zhèxiē gōngjù dōu zài zhège wǎngzhàn shang, nǐ kěyǐ zìjǐ shìshi.
notes.en: Writing: exam-style exercises, ordering sentences and writing characters from pinyin. Handwriting: a trainer and a flashcard deck where I write every character and compare it with the model. All these tools are on this website; you can try them yourself.

notes.hz: 现在每个问题都有工具了……只有说话没有。可是说话最重要！说话是互动的。没有人回答，我就只是对着空气朗读，什么也回不来。
notes.py: Xiànzài měi ge wèntí dōu yǒu gōngjù le…… zhǐyǒu shuōhuà méiyǒu. Kěshì shuōhuà zuì zhòngyào! Shuōhuà shì hùdòng de. Méiyǒu rén huídá, wǒ jiù zhǐshì duìzhe kōngqì lǎngdú, shénme yě huí bu lái.
notes.en: Now every problem has a tool… except speaking. But speaking matters most! It is interactive. If nobody answers, I'm just reading aloud into the air, and nothing comes back.

notes.hz: 这是一个金字塔，一切都在里面。
notes.py: Zhè shì yí gè jīnzìtǎ, yíqiè dōu zài lǐmiàn.
notes.en: This is a pyramid; everything fits into it.

notes.hz: 最下面是Duolingo和Anki。Duolingo给了我第一批词、魔法和对语言的感觉。Anki帮我打好最重要的词的基础。
notes.py: Zuì xiàmiàn shì Duolingo hé Anki. Duolingo gěile wǒ dì-yī pī cí, mófǎ hé duì yǔyán de gǎnjué. Anki bāng wǒ dǎhǎo zuì zhòngyào de cí de jīchǔ.
notes.en: At the bottom are Duolingo and Anki. Duolingo gave me my first words, the magic and a feel for the language. Anki builds a solid base of the most important words.

notes.hz: 上面是阅读和听力。阅读没有时间压力，可是汉字特别难。听力有时间压力，因为要跟上说话的速度，可是它更像拼音，比读汉字容易。
notes.py: Shàngmiàn shì yuèdú hé tīnglì. Yuèdú méiyǒu shíjiān yālì, kěshì Hànzì tèbié nán. Tīnglì yǒu shíjiān yālì, yīnwèi yào gēn shàng shuōhuà de sùdù, kěshì tā gèng xiàng pīnyīn, bǐ dú Hànzì róngyì.
notes.en: Above that are reading and listening. Reading has no time pressure, but Hanzi is extra hard. Listening has time pressure, because you must keep up with the speed of speech, but it is closer to pinyin, so it is easier than reading Hanzi.

notes.hz: 再上面是打字：我打拼音，手机或者电脑写汉字。
notes.py: Zài shàngmiàn shì dǎzì: wǒ dǎ pīnyīn, shǒujī huòzhě diànnǎo xiě Hànzì.
notes.en: Above that is typing: I type pinyin, and the phone or computer writes the Hanzi.

notes.hz: 最上面是说话。说话的时候，魔法就来了。快乐来自我的老师：有人回答我。
notes.py: Zuì shàngmiàn shì shuōhuà. Shuōhuà de shíhou, mófǎ jiù lái le. Kuàilè láizì wǒ de lǎoshī: yǒu rén huídá wǒ.
notes.en: At the very top is speaking. When I speak, the magic happens. The happiness comes from my teacher: someone who answers me.

上面：打字
最上面：说话

notes.hz: 这是我的路。2026年是火马年，2027年2月6号以后是火羊年。我自己属羊，是土羊。
notes.py: Zhè shì wǒ de lù. Èr líng èr liù nián shì huǒ mǎ nián, èr líng èr qī nián èr yuè liù hào yǐhòu shì huǒ yáng nián. Wǒ zìjǐ shǔ yáng, shì tǔ yáng.
notes.en: This is my road. 2026 is the year of the fire horse; from 6 February 2027 it is the fire goat. I was born in a goat year myself: an earth goat.

notes.hz: 路上先有两个考试。十一月二十一号，我在法国米卢斯考旧版三级。十二月十三号，我在卡尔斯鲁厄考新版三级，新版有口语。
notes.py: Lù shang xiān yǒu liǎng ge kǎoshì. Shíyī yuè èrshíyī hào, wǒ zài Fǎguó Mǐlúsī kǎo jiùbǎn sān jí. Shí'èr yuè shísān hào, wǒ zài Kǎ'ěrsīlǔ'è kǎo xīnbǎn sān jí, xīnbǎn yǒu kǒuyǔ.
notes.en: First there are two exams. On 21 November I take the old HSK 3 in Mulhouse, France. On 13 December the new HSK 3 in Karlsruhe, which includes speaking.

notes.hz: 一月二十一号我从法兰克福飞到上海，机票已经买好了！二月六号是春节：马变成羊。我应该在哪个城市过春节？我还不知道。我很想看无人机表演。
notes.py: Yī yuè èrshíyī hào wǒ cóng Fǎlánkèfú fēi dào Shànghǎi, jīpiào yǐjīng mǎi hǎo le! Èr yuè liù hào shì Chūnjié: mǎ biànchéng yáng. Wǒ yīnggāi zài nǎge chéngshì guò Chūnjié? Wǒ hái bù zhīdào. Wǒ hěn xiǎng kàn wúrénjī biǎoyǎn.
notes.en: On 21 January I fly from Frankfurt to Shanghai: my ticket is booked! 6 February is Spring Festival: the horse becomes a goat. Which city should I celebrate in? I don't know yet. I'd love to see a drone show.

notes.hz: 然后我去旅行。这些图片是我想在中国看的东西：冰和雪、寺庙和山、风筝、熊猫、辣的菜、沙漠、新科技。你认识哪个地方吗？
notes.py: Ránhòu wǒ qù lǚxíng. Zhèxiē túpiàn shì wǒ xiǎng zài Zhōngguó kàn de dōngxi: bīng hé xuě, sìmiào hé shān, fēngzheng, xióngmāo, là de cài, shāmò, xīn kējì. Nǐ rènshi nǎge dìfang ma?
notes.en: Then I travel. These pictures are things I want to see in China: ice and snow, temples and mountains, kites, pandas, spicy food, the desert, new technology. Do you recognise a place?

notes.hz: 三月十四号，我想在上海考四级。三月十八号我回家。你觉得我应该在哪儿过春节？
notes.py: Sān yuè shísì hào, wǒ xiǎng zài Shànghǎi kǎo sì jí. Sān yuè shíbā hào wǒ huí jiā. Nǐ juéde wǒ yīnggāi zài nǎr guò Chūnjié?
notes.en: On 14 March I want to take HSK 4 in Shanghai. On 18 March I fly home. Where do you think I should spend Spring Festival?
